pages.title: Full Steam Ahead
pages.text: Cook and collect Mantou from a Steamer.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Set the Steamer over suitable heat and close its top. Find Mantou in JEI’s steaming category.

pages.title: Steam food
pages.text: Stack Steamer tiers above heat and close the top lid. The installed version determines the height limit; no guessed limit is imposed.
